failure_condition: Opening a dialog does not move focus into it; closing it does not restore focus to the opener.
interaction_steps: Open the dialog and record focused element.
Close it and record focus restoration.
expected_outcome: The control uses a modal dialog that manages entry and return focus; defect is reported as an operational focus-management observation.
manual_verification_method: Keyboard-test entry, containment, close, and focus restoration; judge the applicable criterion in context.
dom_testability: Can observe activeElement, dialog open state, and focus restoration.
accessibility_tree_testability: Can inspect dialog role/modal state and the focused node during and after interaction.
limitations: Not every dialog focus-management defect independently establishes a 2.4.3 failure.
